faqs.question: What is the difference between Simple and Advanced Gratuity Calculators?
faqs.answer: The Simple Calculator requires only your consolidated monthly salary (Basic + DA) and service period. The Advanced Calculator lets you itemize Basic Salary and DA, choose your specific separation reason (Resignation, Retirement, Termination, Death, Disability), and inspect daily wage and tax status breakdowns.

faqs.question: Why is monthly salary divided by 26 instead of 30?
faqs.answer: Under Indian labor law and Supreme Court precedents, a month contains 26 actual working days after excluding 4 weekly rest days (Sundays). Hence, daily wage is statutory: Monthly Wage ÷ 26.

faqs.question: Does service of 7 years and 6 months round up to 8 years?
faqs.answer: No. Under the Payment of Gratuity Act, only service exceeding 6 months in an incomplete year rounds up. Thus, 7 years 6 months remains 7 eligible years, while 7 years 7 months rounds up to 8 eligible years.

faqs.question: Is gratuity payable if service is under 5 years?
faqs.answer: For normal resignation, retirement, or termination, 5 years continuous service is mandatory. However, under the proviso to Section 4(1), in the event of death or permanent disability, this 5-year requirement is waived by law.

en.contentHtml:
Complete Guide to Gratuity Calculation

Gratuity is a statutory monetary benefit payable by employers to reward long-term, continuous service rendered by an employee upon resignation, superannuation, retirement, termination, or unfortunate death/disability.

Simple vs Advanced Gratuity Calculation

Depending on your requirements, you can choose between two calculation approaches:

  • Simple Gratuity Calculator: Designed for employees who already know their consolidated monthly wage (Basic + DA) and wish to quickly estimate their gratuity payout based on their years and months of service.
  • Advanced Gratuity Calculator: Provides an itemized breakdown with separated Basic Salary, Dearness Allowance (DA), employment situation (Resignation, Retirement, Termination, Death, or Disability), daily wage basis, 15 days salary rate, and tax exemption guidance.

The Statutory 15/26 Days Gratuity Formula

For all establishments covered under statutory gratuity acts, gratuity is computed based on 15 days of wages for every completed year of service, considering a 26-day working month:

Gratuity = (Monthly Salary × 15 × Eligible Years) ÷ 26

Where Monthly Salary = Basic Salary + Dearness Allowance (DA).

Service Year Rounding Rules (The 6-Month Rule)

Specific rounding rules apply for incomplete years of service:

  • More than 6 additional months (> 6 months, i.e. 7 to 11 months): The incomplete year is rounded UP to the next full year (e.g. 7 years 7 months = 8 eligible years; 8 years 8 months = 9 eligible years).
  • 6 additional months or less (≤ 6 months, i.e. 0 to 6 months): The fractional months are discarded (e.g. 7 years 6 months = 7 eligible years).

The 5-Year Continuous Service Eligibility Rule & Exceptions

Gratuity is legally payable only if an employee has completed at least 5 years of continuous service for normal resignation, retirement, or termination. However, this 5-year condition does NOT apply in the unfortunate event of death or permanent disability of the employee, where gratuity is payable immediately regardless of tenure.

Statutory Tax Exemption Limit

Under Section 10(10) of the Income Tax Act, the statutory tax-free exemption limit for gratuity is ₹20,00,000 (₹20 Lakhs). Gratuity received up to ₹20 Lakhs is 100% tax-free for covered private sector employees. Any excess amount received is treated as taxable salary income.

faqs.question: साधारण और उन्नत ग्रेच्युटी कैलकुलेटर में क्या अंतर है?
faqs.answer: साधारण कैलकुलेटर में केवल मासिक वेतन (मूल + DA) और कुल सेवा वर्ष की आवश्यकता होती है। उन्नत कैलकुलेटर में बेसिक और DA को अलग-अलग दर्ज करने, नौकरी छोड़ने का कारण (इस्तीफा, सेवानिवृत्ति, मृत्यु, विकलांगता) चुनने और टैक्स छूट की विस्तृत स्थिति देखने की सुविधा मिलती है।

faqs.question: मासिक वेतन को 30 के बजाय 26 से क्यों विभाजित किया जाता है?
faqs.answer: भारतीय श्रम कानून और सुप्रीम कोर्ट के फैसलों के अनुसार, 4 साप्ताहिक अवकाश (रविवार) घटाने के बाद एक महीने में 26 कार्य दिवस माने जाते हैं। इसलिए एक दिन का वेतन निकालने के लिए मासिक वेतन को 26 से भाग दिया जाता है।

faqs.question: क्या 7 वर्ष 6 महीने की सेवा को 8 वर्ष माना जाएगा?
faqs.answer: नहीं। ग्रेच्युटी अधिनियम के अनुसार, किसी अधूरे वर्ष में केवल 6 महीने से अधिक (7 से 11 महीने) की सेवा होने पर ही उसे अगले पूरे वर्ष में राउंड ऑफ किया जाता है। अतः 7 वर्ष 6 माह = 7 वर्ष ही रहेगा, जबकि 7 वर्ष 7 माह = 8 वर्ष गिना जाएगा।

faqs.question: क्या 5 वर्ष से कम सेवा पर ग्रेच्युटी मिलती है?
faqs.answer: सामान्य इस्तीफे, सेवानिवृत्ति या सेवा समाप्ति पर कम से कम 5 वर्ष की निरंतर सेवा अनिवार्य है। हालांकि, कर्मचारी की दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण मृत्यु या दुर्घटना/बीमारी से स्थायी विकलांगता की स्थिति में धारा 4(1) के तहत 5 वर्ष की शर्त लागू नहीं होती और तुरंत ग्रेच्युटी देय होती है।

hi.notes: ग्रेच्युटी = (15 × अंतिम बेसिक वेतन + DA × कुल सेवा वर्ष) / 26 (महीने में 26 कार्य दिवस माने जाते हैं)।
hi.contentHtml:
Gratuity Ganana ki Poori Guide

Gratuity ek vadhaanik monetary labh hai jo niyoktaon dwara dirghakalik, nirantar seva ko puraskar dene ke liye dey hai. Yah tab milti hai jab karmachari isteefa deta hai, sevaanivratt hota hai, ya mrityu/apangata ke mamale mein.

Gratuity Sutra

Gratuity Adhiniyam ke tahat covered employees ke liye:

Gratuity = (Antim Vetan x 15 x Seva Varsh) / 26

Gratuity Adhiniyam ke bahar non-covered employees ke liye:

Gratuity = (Antim Vetan x 15 x Seva Varsh) / 30

Patrata Niyam

  • Kam se kam 5 saal ki nirantar seva jaruri hai (mrityu/apangata ko chhodkar)
  • 10 ya adhik karmachariyon wale pratishthan Gratuity Adhiniyam ke antargat aate hain
  • Adhikatam gratuity Rs 20 lakh tak seemit hai
  • 6 mahine se adhik seva ko poorn varsh mana jata hai

Gratuity par Kar

Sarkari karmacharion ke liye gratuity poori tarah kar mukt hai. Niji kshetra ke liye, nyunatam rashi kar mukt hai: vastav mein prapt gratuity, Rs 20 lakh, ya 15 x antim vetan x seva varsh / 26.

Aksar Puche Jane Wale Prashn

Kya gratuity 5 saal se pahle mil sakti hai?

Samanyatah nahin. Mrityu ya sthayi apangata ke mamale mein haan.

Gratuity mein antim vetan kya hai?

Mool vetan aur mahangai bhatta (DA). HRA, bonus aur anya bhatte shamil nahin hain.

Gratuity kab bhugataan ki jani chahiye?

Seva samapti ke 30 dinon ke andar.

Gratuity ki adhikatam seema kya hai?

Gratuity Adhiniyam ke tahat Rs 20 lakh.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre el cálculo simple y el avanzado?
faqs.answer: La calculadora simple utiliza el salario mensual consolidado y los años de servicio. La avanzada permite desglosar el salario básico, complementos salariales, motivo de cese laboral y exenciones fiscales.

faqs.question: ¿Por qué se divide el salario mensual entre 26 días?
faqs.answer: En la legislación laboral aplicable, se consideran 26 días laborables reales al mes tras descontar los 4 días de descanso semanal.

faqs.question: ¿Se redondea un período de 7 años y 6 meses a 8 años?
faqs.answer: No. Solo los períodos que superan estrictamente los 6 meses adicionales (7 meses o más) se redondean al año siguiente. 7 años y 6 meses computan como 7 años.

faqs.question: ¿Se puede cobrar la gratificación con menos de 5 años de servicio?
faqs.answer: En casos normales de renuncia o despido se exigen 5 años de servicio continuo. No obstante, en caso de fallecimiento o incapacidad permanente, la ley exime este requisito mínimo.

es.contentHtml:
Guia Completa para el Calculo de Gratificacion

La gratificacion es un beneficio monetario legal pagadero por los empleadores para recompensar el servicio continuo y prolongado al momento de renuncia, jubilacion, o en casos de muerte o discapacidad permanente.

Formula de Gratificacion

Para empleados cubiertos por la Ley de Gratificacion:

Gratificacion = (Ultimo salario x 15 x Anos de servicio) / 26

Para empleados no cubiertos por la Ley:

Gratificacion = (Ultimo salario x 15 x Anos de servicio) / 30

Reglas de Elegibilidad

  • Minimo 5 anos de servicio continuo requerido (excepto en caso de muerte/discapacidad)
  • Establecimientos con 10 o mas empleados quedan bajo la Ley de Gratificacion
  • Gratificacion maxima limitada a Rs 20 lakh bajo la Ley
  • Mas de 6 meses de servicio se cuenta como un ano completo

Impuesto sobre la Gratificacion

Completamente libre de impuestos para empleados gubernamentales. Para el sector privado, el minimo de los siguientes esta libre de impuestos: la gratificacion real recibida, Rs 20 lakh, o 15 x ultimo salario x anos de servicio / 26.

Preguntas Frecuentes

Se puede obtener gratificacion antes de 5 anos?

Generalmente no, excepto en caso de muerte o discapacidad permanente.

Que se incluye en el ultimo salario?

Salario base y asignacion de carestia (DA). No se incluyen HRA, bonificaciones ni otras asignaciones.

Cuando debe pagarse la gratificacion?

Dentro de los 30 dias posteriores a la terminacion del servicio.

Cual es el limite maximo de gratificacion?

Rs 20 lakh bajo la Ley de Gratificacion de la Pago (Payment of Gratuity Act).

faqs.question: 簡易計算と詳細計算の違いは何ですか？
faqs.answer: 簡易計算は月給と勤続年数のみで概算します。詳細計算では基本給と手当の内訳、退職理由（自己都合、定年、障害、死亡等）、非課税枠の適用状況を詳細に確認できます。

faqs.question: なぜ月給を30日ではなく26日で割るのですか？
faqs.answer: 労働法上、週休4日（日曜日等）を除いた1か月の実働日数が26日と規定されているためです。

faqs.question: 勤続7年6か月は8年に切り上げられますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ。端数が6か月を超える（7か月以上）場合のみ切り上げられます。7年6か月は7年として計算されます。

faqs.question: 勤続5年未満でも退職金・手当は受給できますか？
faqs.answer: 通常の自己都合退職や定年では継続5年の勤務が必要ですが、死亡または業務上の障害による退職の場合は年数制限が免除されます。

ja.notes: 算定基礎賃金に勤続年数に応じた支給率を乗じて退職金額を算出します。

faqs.question: Quelle est la différence entre le mode simple et le mode avancé ?
faqs.answer: Le mode simple utilise le salaire mensuel global et l'ancienneté. Le mode avancé ventile le salaire de base, les indemnités, le motif de départ et les seuils d'exonération fiscale.

faqs.question: Pourquoi le salaire mensuel est-il divisé par 26 jours ?
faqs.answer: La législation du travail retient 26 jours ouvrables par mois, après déduction des 4 jours de repos hebdomadaire.

faqs.question: Une ancienneté de 7 ans et 6 mois est-elle arrondie à 8 ans ?
faqs.answer: Non. Seuls les mois excédant strictement 6 mois (7 mois et plus) sont arrondis à l'année supérieure. 7 ans et 6 mois restent 7 années.

faqs.question: L'indemnité est-elle due avec moins de 5 ans de service ?

Gratuity is a statutory monetary benefit payable by employers to reward long-term, continuous service rendered by an employee upon resignation, superannuation, retirement, termination, or unfortunate death/disability.

Simple vs Advanced Gratuity Calculation

Depending on your requirements, you can choose between two calculation approaches:

  • Simple Gratuity Calculator: Designed for employees who already know their consolidated monthly wage (Basic + DA) and wish to quickly estimate their gratuity payout based on their years and months of service.
  • Advanced Gratuity Calculator: Provides an itemized breakdown with separated Basic Salary, Dearness Allowance (DA), employment situation (Resignation, Retirement, Termination, Death, or Disability), daily wage basis, 15 days salary rate, and tax exemption guidance.

The Statutory 15/26 Days Gratuity Formula

For all establishments covered under statutory gratuity acts, gratuity is computed based on 15 days of wages for every completed year of service, considering a 26-day working month:

Gratuity = (Monthly Salary × 15 × Eligible Years) ÷ 26

Where Monthly Salary = Basic Salary + Dearness Allowance (DA).

Service Year Rounding Rules (The 6-Month Rule)

Specific rounding rules apply for incomplete years of service:

  • More than 6 additional months (> 6 months, i.e. 7 to 11 months): The incomplete year is rounded UP to the next full year (e.g. 7 years 7 months = 8 eligible years; 8 years 8 months = 9 eligible years).
  • 6 additional months or less (≤ 6 months, i.e. 0 to 6 months): The fractional months are discarded (e.g. 7 years 6 months = 7 eligible years).

The 5-Year Continuous Service Eligibility Rule & Exceptions

Gratuity is legally payable only if an employee has completed at least 5 years of continuous service for normal resignation, retirement, or termination. However, this 5-year condition does NOT apply in the unfortunate event of death or permanent disability of the employee, where gratuity is payable immediately regardless of tenure.

Statutory Tax Exemption Limit

Under Section 10(10) of the Income Tax Act, the statutory tax-free exemption limit for gratuity is ₹20,00,000 (₹20 Lakhs). Gratuity received up to ₹20 Lakhs is 100% tax-free for covered private sector employees. Any excess amount received is treated as taxable salary income.

faqs.question: Was ist der Unterschied zwischen einfacher und erweiterter Berechnung?
faqs.answer: Der einfache Rechner benötigt nur das Monatsgehalt und die Dienstjahre. Der erweiterte Rechner trennt Grundgehalt, Zulagen, den Beendigungsgrund und steuerliche Freibeträge auf.

faqs.question: Warum wird das Monatsgehalt durch 26 Tage geteilt?
faqs.answer: Arbeitsrechtlich wird ein Arbeitsmonat nach Abzug von 4 Ruhetagen mit 26 tatsächlichen Werktagen angesetzt.

faqs.question: Wird eine Dienstzeit von 7 Jahren und 6 Monaten auf 8 Jahre aufgerundet?
faqs.answer: Nein. Nur Restmonate von mehr als 6 Monaten (ab dem 7. Monat) werden aufgerundet. 7 Jahre und 6 Monate gelten als 7 volle Dienstjahre.

faqs.question: Besteht Anspruch bei weniger als 5 Jahren Betriebszugehörigkeit?
faqs.answer: Bei regulärem Ausscheiden oder Kündigung sind 5 Jahre Betriebszugehörigkeit Pflicht. Bei Tod oder Erwerbsunfähigkeit entfällt diese Mindestdauer gesetzlich.

faqs.question: Qual a diferença entre a calculadora simples e a avançada?
faqs.answer: A simples utiliza o salário mensal total e o tempo de serviço. A avançada detalha salário base, adicionais, motivo do encerramento do contrato e isenções tributárias.

faqs.question: Por que o salário mensal é dividido por 26 dias?
faqs.answer: A legislação trabalhista estabelece 26 dias úteis no mês após descontar 4 dias de repouso semanal.

faqs.question: Um período de 7 anos e 6 meses arredonda para 8 anos?
faqs.answer: Não. Apenas frações superiores a 6 meses (7 meses ou mais) são arredondadas para cima. 7 anos e 6 meses contam como 7 anos.

faqs.question: O benefício é devido com menos de 5 anos de trabalho?
faqs.answer: Em demissões ou aposentadorias comuns exige-se 5 anos contínuos. Em caso de morte ou invalidez permanente, a carência é legalmente dispensada.

입사일과 퇴사일을 입력하여 재직일수를 산정합니다.

faqs.question: 일반 계산과 고급 계산의 차이점은 무엇인가요?
faqs.answer: 일반 계산은 총 월급여와 근속연수로 빠르게 산출합니다. 고급 계산은 기본급과 수당 분리, 퇴직 사유(자진퇴사, 정년, 장해, 사망 등), 비과세 한도까지 정밀 분석합니다.

faqs.question: 월급을 30일이 아닌 26일로 나누는 이유는 무엇인가요?
faqs.answer: 노동법 규정에 따라 4일의 주휴일을 제외한 월간 실제 근무일수를 26일로 표준 산정하기 때문입니다.

faqs.question: 근속 7년 6개월은 8년으로 올림 계산되나요?
faqs.answer: 아닙니다. 잔여 기간이 6개월을 초과(7개월 이상)할 때만 1년으로 올림되며, 7년 6개월은 7년으로 인정됩니다.

faqs.question: 5년 미만 근무 시에도 수당이 지급되나요?
faqs.answer: 일반 퇴직의 경우 최소 5년의 근속이 필수적이지만, 사망이나 영구 장해로 인한 퇴직 시에는 근속 연수 기준이 면제됩니다.

ko.notes: 퇴직금 ＝ 1일 평균임금 × 30일 × (총 재직일수 ÷ 365). 계속 근로기간 1년에 대해 30일분 이상의 평균임금을 지급합니다.

faqs.question: Qual è la differenza tra calcolo semplice e avanzato?
faqs.answer: La modalità semplice calcola sulla retribuzione mensile e gli anni di servizio. Quella avanzata suddivide stipendio base, indennità, motivo di cessazione ed esenzioni fiscali.

faqs.question: Perché lo stipendio mensile viene diviso per 26?
faqs.answer: La normativa fissa in 26 giorni lavorativi effettivi la durata mensile, escludendo i 4 giorni di riposo settimanale.

faqs.question: Un servizio di 7 anni e 6 mesi viene arrotondato a 8 anni?
faqs.answer: No. Solo i periodi che superano i 6 mesi (da 7 a 11 mesi) vengono arrotondati all'anno successivo. 7 anni e 6 mesi restano 7 anni.

faqs.question: L'indennità spetta con meno di 5 anni di servizio?
faqs.answer: Per dimissioni volontarie o pensionamento ordinario sono richiesti 5 anni. In caso di decesso o invalidità permanente, tale requisito è revocato per legge.

it.notes: Quota annua = Retribuzione Lorda Annua / 13.5. Il fondo pregresso viene rivalutato all’1.5% fisso + 75% dell’inflazione ISTAT.
